evidence.note: TrigReason diagnoses three specific SRM (small reasoning model) failure modes -- path divergence at the start, cognitive overload on hard steps (signaled by abnormally low token-level perplexity/overconfidence, present in 94.6% of incorrect trajectories vs. 38.1% baseline), and recovery inability (persisting on erroneous paths, signaled by hesitation-word loops) -- and replaces SpecReason's per-step LRM polling verifier (shown to reject 50-81% of the SRM's own correct or self-generated steps due to inter-judge inconsistency) with three targeted, event-triggered LRM interventions, matching full-LRM accuracy while offloading 1.70x-4.79x more tokens to the SRM than SpecReason and cutting edge-cloud latency 43.9%/API cost 73.3%.
evidence.title: TrigReason: Trigger-Based Collaboration between Small and Large Reasoning Models
